beats.text: Five psychological tricks that make motivation far easier to find.
One. Shrink the first step until it's almost silly. 'Write one sentence.' Starting beats planning.
Two. Use the two-minute rule. If it takes under two minutes, do it now and build momentum.
Three. Never break the chain. Mark each day you show up — the growing streak starts to pull you.
Four. Pair the dull task with a treat — a favourite playlist, good coffee. Reward the habit, not just the result.
Five. Tell someone your goal. We hate letting down a person far more than letting down ourselves.
Motivation isn't a feeling you wait for. It's a trap you set, so action happens almost on its own.
